picks.name: Junction Crew in Navy Ribbed Fleece
picks.why: The hiking and outdoor outfits still have no fleece mid-layer. This is a regular-fit crew in a ribbed wool-blend fleece from an Italian mill, with raglan sleeves for reach and bound cuffs and hem, so it reads like a textured knit rather than a technical fleece. Wear it over a grey marl tee with the 502s and Sambas, or under the waxed Ashby on the coast path.

picks.name: 7006 Essential T-Shirt, Norway Spruce
picks.why: Tees are still the biggest gap and every formula starts with one. This is a plain organic cotton crew, enzyme-washed for a lived-in feel, in a deep spruce green with only a small woven tab, now 30% off. Wear it under the raglan sweats or the fleece with the 502s and Sambas.

picks.name: 100% Merino Crew Neck Jumper, Navy
picks.why: The office outfit still has no knit. A plain fine-gauge merino crew with ribbed cuffs and hem sits neatly under a jacket and reads smart without trying. Wear it over a charcoal tee with the fawn chinos and brown Docs.
